nodes.label: Control Effectiveness E
nodes.rationale: E1 absent/unproven through E5 with failure/bypass testing and continuous monitoring. Existence, design adequacy, coverage and real performance are assessed separately; a good average does not offset an important failure. On fresh computation the system re-checks evidence validity, date, active state and E conditions and treats invalid controls as no reduction. Recovery controls may have E but E alone never lowers I.

nodes.label: Control Credit Revalidation at Computation (fallback to E1)
nodes.norm_label: control credit revalidation at computation (fallback to e1)
nodes.rationale: E conditions are re-checked on computation; removed evidence, inactive control, future-dated test or lost conditions drop computational credit to E1 and Bc is recomputed from remaining valid barriers. Previously approved scores are not rewritten.

nodes.label: E2 Requires Proven Limited Effect
nodes.rationale: Previously control existence, execution evidence and test date could suffice; now real limited effect must be proven with method, result and sample reason. Installation alone gives no reduction credit; legacy E2 without proof gets no credit on fresh computation (no automatic numeric conversion).

nodes.label: Management Report (/reports/)
nodes.rationale: Shows risk counts per level from latest approved current assessment, critical-service coverage, overdue high/critical actions, problematic acceptances, key controls with valid E3, uncertainty/dependency concentration and level changes; no sums or averages of ordinal scores.

nodes.label: control_assessment_detail.html (Control Effectiveness Assessment Detail)
nodes.rationale: Effectiveness sheet of a control: E badge, suspended flag, and a warning listing problems when current data no longer supports the recorded E. Shows scope, existence and design, coverage and population, critical points, exceptions and known gap, test method/window/sample, results, E4/E5 conditions, rationale and confidence for E, verifier, evidence valid-until, method version, evidence list, and paths that rely on this assessment.

nodes.label: control_assessment_form.html (Control Effectiveness Assessment Form)
nodes.rationale: Fieldset-grouped effectiveness form beside the control summary, the E level scale (Section 16) and the E conditions of the active method version.

nodes.label: Path barrier B = min(B0, Bc) (Section 15)
nodes.rationale: B0 is the path's base capability; Bc comes from the E levels of the path's controls under method rules, otherwise Bc = 5. A suspended control or one with stale evidence counts as E1. B for the path is the lower of B0 and Bc. Only preventive controls linked to the same risk and having an effectiveness assessment can be chosen; a bypass route or exceptional account that passes all barriers is a separate path.

nodes.label: Control effectiveness E-level conditions (Section 16)
nodes.rationale: E2 and above: the control's real effect is proven by test evidence with method, result and sample rationale recorded; installation alone earns no reduction and a control without evidence is E1. E3 and above: adequate design, operating effectiveness, coverage at least the threshold, all critical points, no known gap, sample at least the threshold, and a verifier other than the control owner. E4: sustained operation over the review period. E5: additionally failure and bypass testing and continuous monitoring.

nodes.label: Control evidence staleness window
nodes.rationale: Evidence for a key control goes stale key_age days after the test ends, for other controls other_age days; a control with stale evidence counts only as E1 in Bc.

nodes.label: control_table.html (control list partial)
nodes.rationale: Shared by control library, risk page and Annex A page; a control's code links to its page only when visible_control_ids is None or contains the control (visibility scoping).

nodes.norm_label: soa_detail.html (iso annex a control soa page)

nodes.label: risk_table.html
nodes.rationale: Shared risk table for scenario, service and risk-universe cell pages; hide_service and hide_scenario drop the duplicate column.

nodes.label: scenario_detail.html
nodes.rationale: Reference scenario page with version badge, narrative, event, conditions and consequence, and the risks built from it; risk creation only from active scenarios.

nodes.label: Organizational control mapped to ISO 27001 Annex A
nodes.norm_label: organizational control mapped to iso 27001 annex a
nodes.rationale: An organizational control is a specific mechanism with an owner that risks rely on, mapped to the Annex A controls of ISO 27001.

nodes.label: control_detail.html (Control Detail)
nodes.rationale: Control objective and mechanism, kind, owner and operator; effectiveness assessments (an unassessed control counts as E1); mapped ISO 27001 Annex A controls with SoA applicability (links only for users who can view the SoA); risks that rely on the control; attachments and comments.

nodes.label: control_list.html (Control Library)
nodes.rationale: Filtered, paginated library of organizational controls, rendered with the shared control table.

nodes.label: applicability_badge.html (SoA Applicability Badge)
nodes.rationale: Undetermined, applicable (with implementation status) or not applicable badge for an Annex A control's applicability record.

nodes.label: SoA applicability vs control-mapping consistency check
nodes.norm_label: soa applicability vs control-mapping consistency check
nodes.rationale: Flags an Annex A control marked applicable with no active organisational control mapped, and one marked not applicable while controls are mapped; one of the two must be corrected.

nodes.label: initiator_form.html (Initiator Factor A Form)
nodes.rationale: Edits the initiator factor A of an assessment. Shows the risk's initiator boundary (initiator, count unit, scope, count exclusions) and warns when the risk is incomplete: A is saved but cannot be finally approved (Section 13). Shows the rate-based level suggestion and the reasons data is insufficient, next to the A scale table (Section 14).

nodes.label: Initiator frequency scale A (Section 14)
nodes.rationale: A is graded by annual rate or forward-looking evidence. The chosen route and its rationale are required, and the two columns are never summed or averaged. Zero events in one year does not prove a rate below 0.1. With insufficient data A is recorded as 'Unknown' or forward-looking evidence is reviewed. An incomplete risk definition blocks final approval of A (Section 13).

nodes.label: Assessment Kinds (inherent, current, target)
nodes.rationale: Inherent assumes named excluded controls; current uses active controls and real evidence and drives priority/acceptance; target is a forecast with assumption, test criterion and due date. 'Post-action' is a fresh current assessment, not a fourth computational kind; promising a tool does not reduce the current result.

nodes.label: risk_treatment.html (risk page treatment and acceptance section)
nodes.norm_label: risk_treatment.html (risk page treatment and acceptance section)
nodes.rationale: A treatment plan is written only when the risk moves to 'treatment programme' with an approved current assessment; shows plan and containment deadlines, and blocks acceptance when the decision assessment carries a binding prohibition (out of acceptance authority).

nodes.label: Non-normal acceptance (incomplete or low-confidence assessment)
nodes.rationale: When the assessment is incomplete or low-confidence the acceptance is not normal: it needs an evidence-collection deadline and temporary authorization from a higher authority; exceeded customer tolerance restricts general acceptance authority.

nodes.label: Acceptance authority limits (out of authority / restricted)
nodes.norm_label: acceptance authority limits (out of authority / restricted)

nodes.label: Escalation precedence rule (ongoing incident, binding prohibition, customer tolerance exceeded)
nodes.norm_label: escalation precedence rule (ongoing incident, binding prohibition, customer tolerance exceeded)
nodes.rationale: Escalation flags take precedence over the base level and must carry a rationale and evidence; the result panel lists escalation reasons.

nodes.label: Impact profile (dimensions x stakeholders, I = max valid level)
nodes.norm_label: impact profile (dimensions x stakeholders, i = max valid level)
nodes.rationale: I is the highest valid level across impact dimensions and stakeholders (the organisation plus affected banks). Zero means no effect and unknown is never filled with zero; unknown or unrecorded cells mean there is no defensible upper bound yet.

nodes.label: Initiator factor A (rate basis: count, period, denominator, coverage)
nodes.norm_label: initiator factor a (rate basis: count, period, denominator, coverage)
nodes.rationale: A is recorded with a basis; for the rate basis the unique initiator count over a period (with optional denominator and logging coverage) yields a system-suggested A level and insufficiency warnings; rationale and evidence are required.

nodes.label: Likelihood model (L from A x B table)
nodes.norm_label: likelihood model (l from a x b table)
nodes.rationale: Scenario B is the largest B among realization paths, and L comes only from the method version's A x B table; problems, incomplete reasons and approval blockers are listed.

nodes.label: Realization paths (B0, preventive controls E, Bc, path B)
nodes.norm_label: realization paths (b0, preventive controls e, bc, path b)
nodes.rationale: Each path has a base B0 with rationale, preventive controls with effectiveness E from control assessments, a controlled Bc and a resulting path B; independence of barriers and exceptions are documented.

nodes.label: Assessment result (L, I, L x I score, base and decision level, confidence)
nodes.norm_label: assessment result (l, i, l x i score, base and decision level, confidence)
nodes.rationale: The result is computed live until approval and frozen on approval; when the score is a range, the decision is taken on its upper bound.

nodes.label: Incomplete assessment blocks normal acceptance
nodes.rationale: An incomplete assessment lists its reasons and blocks normal acceptance.

nodes.label: risks/coverage.html (risk universe: service x category coverage)
nodes.norm_label: risks/coverage.html (risk universe: service x category coverage)

nodes.label: coverage_badge.html
nodes.rationale: Status badge of one service x category cell (Coverage, saved or not): reviewed, not relevant, or pending.

nodes.label: coverage_cell.html
nodes.rationale: One risk-universe table cell. Tooltip shows category, reason, reviewer and date; editors click through to the cell status page and return via ?next; below the badge the count of active risks for that service and category links to the register.

nodes.label: Critical service coverage (report definition)
nodes.rationale: A critical service counts as covered only when all categories are reviewed AND every active risk of the service has a complete current assessment; stricter than the risk-universe page metric.

nodes.label: Risk category does not affect score
nodes.norm_label: risk category does not affect score
nodes.rationale: Each risk instance has one main category used for owner assignment and reporting only (v5 section 5); categories are never deleted, inactive ones leave the coverage table but keep history.

nodes.label: Service-bank recovery times (RTO, MTPD, RPO)
nodes.rationale: Each bank linked to a service carries RTO, MTPD and RPO in minutes, tolerance notes, a BIA reference and a validity window.

nodes.label: impact_form.html (Impact Profile Form)
nodes.rationale: Impact profile grid for one assessment: one card per affected party (Datin and each affected bank) and one row per impact dimension with level, actual value, unit, financial basis, rationale and evidence. Header shows service criticality, RTO, MTPD and financial basis; Datin's financial basis is approved operating revenue of the last 12 months, written on row F. Shows the system's suggested level per dimension.

nodes.label: customer_list.html (Bank List)
nodes.rationale: Filtered list of banks (customers): name, key-customer badge, financial basis in rials (thousands separator), active status.

nodes.label: Impact profile recording rules
nodes.rationale: Level 0 means 'no impact' and needs a rationale. Missing data is recorded as 'Unknown' with a rationale, never as 0. From outage duration and loss amount the system suggests the S and F levels; choosing another level needs a rationale. Cells left 'not recorded' are not saved.

nodes.label: Provisional S floor without approved RTO/MTPD
nodes.norm_label: provisional s floor without approved rto/mtpd
nodes.rationale: For a critical service and a bank with no approved RTO or MTPD, the S (service) level must not be recorded below the provisional level unless there is a rationale and approval from the methodology custodian.

nodes.label: risk_assessments.html (Risk Page Assessments Section)
nodes.rationale: Assessments section of the risk page. Current risk level is the decision level of the current approved assessment, shown with its approval date. The table lists code, kind, method version, horizon in months, creator, status, and decision level only for approved assessments. With more than one assessment, a GET form selects two to four to compare, oldest first.

nodes.label: workspace.html (Risk Assessment Workspace)
nodes.rationale: Lists visible assessments with risk, code, status, likelihood, impact, score and decision level from the computed outcome. Non-approved assessments are marked provisional. Offers a 'new risk assessment' link to the candidates page when the user may start one.

nodes.label: path_form.html (Likelihood Path Form)
nodes.rationale: Create or edit form for an assessment path, with the B0 base-capability scale (Section 15) and the Bc rules derived from the E levels of the path's controls as reference.

nodes.label: staff_import.html (HR staff import with dry-run report)
nodes.norm_label: staff_import.html (hr staff import with dry-run report)
nodes.rationale: A dry-run report (sections with counts and lines) is shown first and nothing is saved until the user confirms via accounts:staff_import_confirm; cancel discards it.

nodes.label: spa_missing.html (React build missing notice)
nodes.rationale: Shown when frontend/dist is absent; tells the operator to run npm ci && npm run build (done automatically in the Docker image) and links back to the classic pages meanwhile.

nodes.label: API form/page bridge (/api/forms/, /api/pages/)
nodes.rationale: /api/forms/ and /api/pages/ execute the same Django view of each page (apps/api/bridge.py), so permissions, validation, messages, audit and post-save redirect stay identical to the Django page. Adding a form means one line in apps/api/bridge_pages.py and one route in frontend/src/app/routes.tsx.

nodes.label: Frontend checks (lint, Vitest + axe, Playwright e2e)
nodes.norm_label: frontend checks (lint, vitest + axe, playwright e2e)
nodes.rationale: `npm run test:e2e` builds the UI and serves it via e2e/server.mjs exactly as Django would (same CSP), on desktop and mobile in both themes with axe; API responses are test fixtures (src/test/fixtures.ts) and the app itself has no demo data. PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=chrome supports old macOS.

nodes.label: React frontend (frontend/, served at /app/)
nodes.rationale: Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind and Radix, reading the Django API (/api/). Pages are migrated one by one; until a page is migrated the menu opens the Django page and says so. Management report and Django admin remain classic pages. Dev mode needs Django runserver first, then `npm run dev` on port 5173 proxying everything else to Django; `npm run build` produces the bundle Django serves.

nodes.label: Login redirect to SPA (/app/login/, ?classic=1 fallback)
nodes.rationale: Once the frontend is built, /accounts/login/ forwards to /app/login/ which uses the same Django form and audit trail; the old login page stays reachable with ?classic=1.

nodes.label: Menu groups named after methodology stages
nodes.norm_label: menu groups named after methodology stages
nodes.rationale: Menu groups (workbench, risk identification, assessment, treatment, questionnaire, organisation catalog, system administration) are defined in apps/api/session.py; the Django menu in templates/base.html has the same groups, so every change must be made in both.

nodes.label: SPA CSP with Trusted Types and per-request nonce
nodes.norm_label: spa csp with trusted types and per-request nonce
nodes.rationale: Django serves the SPA with CSP, Trusted Types and a fresh nonce per request; `npm run dev` does not enforce this policy, so final verification is done on the production build or via Playwright tests.

nodes.label: change_list.html (Audit Data Changes)
nodes.rationale: Lists history records: time, user (or 'command line' when none), change type, record with change reason, and field-level old to new diffs. For an update with no visible field diff it explains that a hidden field such as password or role changed.

nodes.label: event_list.html (Audit Events)
nodes.rationale: Lists login and security events with user, event badge (warning style for login_failed and permission_denied), summary and IP address. The Excel export link carries the same GET filters as the page.

nodes.label: audit/tabs.html (Audit Tabs)
nodes.rationale: Audit records header with two tabs, events and data changes, active by resolver url_name.

nodes.label: SPA HTML Entry (frontend/index.html)
nodes.rationale: Vite entry document: lang=fa, dir=rtl, data-theme=dark default, theme-color #09090B (canvas token), viewport-fit=cover for safe-area insets, referrer same-origin, noscript notice; mounts #root and loads /src/main.tsx.

nodes.label: Shield-with-Checkmark Favicon
nodes.rationale: 32x32 rounded dark square (#18181B, the 'surface' token) containing a violet (#A78BFA, 'accent-text' token) shield outline with a white (#FAFAFA, 'fg' token) checkmark: a security/risk-protection mark in the app's palette.

nodes.label: Semantic Color Role Tokens (canvas, panel, surface, accent, ...)
nodes.norm_label: semantic color role tokens (canvas, panel, surface, accent, ...)
nodes.rationale: All colors defined only in src/styles/index.css; components know only role names (bg-panel, text-muted, border-line). data-theme on <html> is set by ThemeProvider and read from stored preference before render to avoid flicker. Light warning/success are darker than Tailwind defaults to pass axe contrast in both themes.

nodes.label: C: Obligations & Compliance
nodes.rationale: Levels from internal procedure deviation up to service prohibition or licence loss; assessor must link contract clause, valid notice or legal opinion. Not extracted automatically from contracts; internal acceptance does not license a breach.

nodes.label: D: Data & Integrity
nodes.rationale: Confidentiality, integrity, privacy and output trustworthiness graded by data class, misuse potential, unique individuals and transaction effect; count thresholds are proposals pending security committee approval. Backups alone do not prove ledger reconstruction. Selected manually with reason and evidence; no automatic classification.

nodes.label: F: Financial (gross loss / approved 12-month revenue)
nodes.rationale: Credible gross loss of one scenario realisation divided by the stakeholder's own approved basis; insurance shown separately as net and decision basis stays gross until coverage is realised. Missing financial data is not zero. System suggests the level from amount and basis.

nodes.label: Impact Profile (S/D/F/C/R per stakeholder)
nodes.rationale: One column for Datin and each related bank, one row per dimension; each cell has level 0-5 or 'unknown', optional actual value/unit, financial basis (F only), reason and evidence. 'Unrecorded', 'unknown' (missing data with reason) and zero (no effect, with reason) are distinct; unknown is never replaced by zero and an all-zero profile is invalid. CIA labels map into S (availability) and D (confidentiality/integrity) without extra scores.

nodes.label: R: Reputation & Customer Relationship
nodes.rationale: Levels from limited internal dissatisfaction to termination by a key customer; for future scenarios the predicted reaction must be supported by declared sensitivity, contract clause, verified similar experience or written relationship-owner opinion. Media speculation alone is insufficient.

nodes.label: S: Service & Continuity (RTO / MTPD)
nodes.rationale: Graded by disruption duration d relative to RTO and MTPD and service criticality; RTO must be positive and below MTPD, equality with MTPD is level 5. System only suggests S from duration and valid bounds; common cause, quality degradation and customer obligations are judged by the assessor. Method-owner approval for temporary S<4 is not yet structurally recorded.

nodes.label: Open Gaps vs. Method (S<4 approval, financial fields, causal judgement, ranges, zero-event, E3 example, approval status)
nodes.norm_label: open gaps vs. method (s<4 approval, financial fields, causal judgement, ranges, zero-event, e3 example, approval status)
nodes.rationale: Lists where implementation intentionally or provisionally diverges from the method text; scales, thresholds and proposed authorities are not equivalent to organisational approval or legal validity.

nodes.label: Zero-Event 120-Month A1 Suggestion Rule
nodes.rationale: Current software rule treats a 120-month zero-event period as sufficient to suggest A1; flagged as a software heuristic, not statistical proof or a substitute for data-adequacy review and expert judgement.

nodes.label: Comparison trend vs first column
nodes.rationale: Down arrow (green) means less risk and up arrow (red) more risk, relative to the first (oldest) column. Each impact dimension is the highest level across the Datin and bank columns; '?' marks an unknown or unrecorded cell. When method versions differ, part of a level change may come from the method change and is reported separately from the effect of treatment actions (Section 21).

nodes.label: Shared point of failure
nodes.rationale: A dependency flagged is_shared_point is shown as a shared point of failure wherever dependencies are listed.

nodes.label: Dependency responsibility boundary
nodes.rationale: For a dependency: infrastructure owner, control operator, evidence provider, change authority and incident contact. Shown as 'not recorded' when has_boundary is false.

nodes.label: asset_detail.html (Asset Detail)
nodes.rationale: Asset kind, owner unit, owner, data classification and CIA labels, followed by the dependent services table.

nodes.label: asset_list.html (Asset List)
nodes.rationale: Filtered, paginated asset list: code, name, kind, owner unit, owner, data class, CIA, active status.

nodes.label: commitment_list.html (Commitment List)
nodes.rationale: Filtered list of commitments: title, kind, clause reference, linked services, bank (or 'all'), owner and validity window.

nodes.label: dependents_table.html (Dependent Services Table)
nodes.rationale: Services that depend on this service, supplier or asset. The view passes only dependencies of services the user may see (visible_dependents), so the empty state says no service you can see depends on this one. Flags critical services and shared points of failure.

nodes.label: validity.html (Validity Window)
nodes.rationale: Renders a record's valid_from / valid_until in Jalali dates, a dash when neither is set, and an 'expired' badge when record.is_expired.

nodes.label: service_detail.html (Service Detail)
nodes.rationale: Service header (critical, inactive), mission, owner unit, owner, lifecycle stage and environment; then commitments, dependencies (to service, supplier or asset, with alternative and responsibility boundary), dependent services, banks with RTO/MTPD/RPO and BIA reference, risk-universe coverage cells for active services, and the service's risks.

nodes.label: service_list.html (Service List)
nodes.rationale: Filtered list of services and processes: code, name with critical badge, kind, owner unit, owner, lifecycle stage, status.

nodes.label: supplier_detail.html (Supplier Detail)
nodes.rationale: Supplier with critical/inactive badges, supplied service or goods, contract owner, and the dependent services table.

nodes.label: supplier_list.html (Supplier List)
nodes.rationale: Filtered list of suppliers: name with critical badge, description, contract owner, status.

nodes.label: Score drop from method change is not control improvement
nodes.norm_label: score drop from method change is not control improvement
nodes.rationale: Level changes across method versions are flagged; a lower score caused by a method change is not evidence of better controls, while same-method changes require checking assumptions and evidence.

nodes.label: Risk scores are never summed or averaged
nodes.norm_label: risk scores are never summed or averaged
nodes.rationale: Each risk is counted once using its latest approved current assessment; an unachieved target assessment never stands in for current.

nodes.label: graphify skill (/graphify trigger)
nodes.rationale: When the user types /graphify, the installed graphify skill (.claude/skills/graphify/SKILL.md) is used before doing anything else.

nodes.label: graphify query-first navigation rule
nodes.rationale: graphify query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output, so they run before any grep or source read; raw files are read only for lines already located; the rule is propagated into every code-exploring subagent prompt; wiki/index.md is preferred for broad navigation.

nodes.label: graphify update after code changes
nodes.rationale: Running `graphify update .` after code changes keeps the graph current at no API cost (AST-only). graph.json is rewritten whole on every build, so large PR diffs to it are expected and are not churn.

nodes.label: Docker Compose prod profile (db, web, monitoring, nginx)
nodes.norm_label: docker compose prod profile (db, web, monitoring, nginx)
nodes.rationale: web runs Django under gunicorn and auto-runs migrate and collectstatic on start; nginx on port 80 proxies to web and serves static files; db is PostgreSQL 17.

nodes.label: ERM System (Enterprise Risk Management web app)
nodes.norm_label: erm system (enterprise risk management web app)
nodes.rationale: Web system for risk registration and assessment, mitigation actions, approval workflow and reporting, built with Django and PostgreSQL; Persian RTL UI, run with Docker on the organisation's internal server.

nodes.label: Project structure (config, apps, frontend, templates, docker, docs)
nodes.norm_label: project structure (config, apps, frontend, templates, docker, docs)
nodes.rationale: apps/ holds core, accounts, organization, workcalendar, audit, catalog, risks, actions, workflow, reports and api (the React API); templates/ and static/ hold the base template, Vazirmatn font, RTL Bootstrap and htmx; docs/ holds business rules.

nodes.label: Settings modules (base, dev, prod)
nodes.rationale: config/settings/base.py shared (DEBUG off), dev.py for manage.py and pytest locally (DEBUG on), prod.py for gunicorn and the Docker container; override via DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE.

nodes.label: check_schema management command
nodes.rationale: Diagnoses ProgrammingError 'column/relation does not exist' by comparing the database to models and migrations, naming missing or extra columns/tables, unapplied migrations, and applied migrations whose files no longer exist.

nodes.label: Pushed migrations are never regenerated or edited
nodes.norm_label: pushed migrations are never regenerated or edited
nodes.rationale: A migration pushed on any branch (even unmerged) is never rebuilt or edited; every model change gets a new migration, because a database that already ran the old version treats it as applied and would never run the new version.

nodes.label: user_list.html (user listing with roles and status)
nodes.norm_label: user_list.html (user listing with roles and status)

nodes.label: Risk Level Colors from Method Version
nodes.norm_label: risk level colors from method version
nodes.rationale: Level colors are data from the method version; LevelBadge shows them only on dot/border and always writes the level name so color is never the only cue; applied via React style (CSSOM) so it works under CSP without unsafe-inline.

nodes.label: SPA Security (strict CSP with nonce, Trusted Types, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML)
nodes.norm_label: spa security (strict csp with nonce, trusted types, no dangerouslysetinnerhtml)
nodes.rationale: Django serves /app/ with strict CSP and Trusted Types; Zod runs without new Function; Radix styles get the nonce; no keys or tokens in the UI, session in HttpOnly cookie, CSRF from cookie to header; localStorage only for theme and menu state; hidden buttons are not a security decision.

nodes.label: Assessment Quality Review Workflow
nodes.rationale: States draft, in quality review, referred to working group, approved; a different authorised reviewer (not the assessor) approves, returns or refers. Pre-submission and pre-approval checks cover owner, service, banks, assumptions, target due date, horizon reason, initiator boundary, A evidence, at least one path with B0 evidence, impact cells, reasons, positive-level evidence and engine input validity. Workflow is a system mechanism, not a new rank in the risk formula.

nodes.label: Scope Snapshot at Approval
nodes.rationale: Service, customers, owner and scenario attributes are frozen at approval for historical reference; later control or data changes do not rewrite an approved result.

nodes.label: Scope Preservation at Approval
nodes.rationale: Service, customers, owner, category, description, scope, initiator, counting unit and horizon are recorded at approval and the recorded scope is displayed; impact-profile customer columns of approved assessments also come from this snapshot. No synthetic snapshots for legacy assessments.

nodes.label: Admin Panel Edits Limited to Drafts
nodes.norm_label: admin panel edits limited to drafts
nodes.rationale: Admin path could previously alter final assessments; now editing is draft-only and history revert is blocked.

nodes.label: Delegated Approval of Normal Assessments
nodes.rationale: An authorised representative can approve normal dossiers; disagreements still require decision text and working-group meeting date.

nodes.label: Retirement Requires Path-Removal or Scope-Exit Evidence
nodes.norm_label: retirement requires path-removal or scope-exit evidence

nodes.label: Accessibility Target WCAG 2.2 AA
nodes.rationale: axe in Vitest per component/page and in Playwright on desktop/mobile in both themes; skip link first, focus moves to main after navigation, form errors both inline and in a linked summary.

nodes.label: Responsive Layout (collapsible RTL sidebar, container-query tables)
nodes.norm_label: responsive layout (collapsible rtl sidebar, container-query tables)
nodes.rationale: Sidebar collapses to icons (persisted in localStorage) and becomes a drawer below 1024px; --gutter plus safe-area insets; tables turn into stacked cards below 44rem via container query except data-matrix tables that keep scrolling with sticky first column.

nodes.label: Typography (Inter + Vazirmatn, Persian digits)
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted variable fonts (no CDN); 12/14/15px scale with 1.65-1.8 line height for Persian; fluid clamp headings; Persian digits via Intl.NumberFormat('fa-IR') while codes and usernames stay Latin LTR with .code and <bdi>.

nodes.label: Risk Acceptance & Treatment (§19 proposed authorities)
nodes.rationale: Proposed authority, deadline and max acceptance validity per decision level (low 12 months ... critical 30 days with 24h containment). Low confidence, unknown constraints or incomplete critical impact are not normal acceptance; no automatic renewal; reminders 30 and 7 days before expiry. Acceptance is performed in the separate actions module; continuing/stopping a bank service remains a human decision.

nodes.label: Assessment Horizon (default 12 months)
nodes.rationale: Likelihood time window; method version default is 12 months and a different horizon requires a stated reason before submission.

nodes.label: Barrier Credit Bc
nodes.rationale: Derived from valid E of selected controls, independence flag and open critical exception: 5 none proven, 4 at least one E2, 3 at least one E3 closing the essential step, 2 at least one E4/E5, 1 two independent E4/E5 barriers each stopping the path. Bc is not the mean of E nor 6-E; independence is not shown by different names or tools.

nodes.label: Baseline Feasibility B0
nodes.rationale: Path feasibility without crediting assessed controls, 1-5 or unknown; B0=1 needs evidence of two very exceptional independent conditions; lack of path information never justifies B0=1.

nodes.label: Decision Level (after impact floor)
nodes.rationale: Level used for decisions after applying the impact floor and precedence rules; the raw product is never changed.

nodes.label: Impact I = max(S, D, F, C, R) across stakeholders
nodes.norm_label: impact i = max(s, d, f, c, r) across stakeholders
nodes.rationale: I is the highest valid consequence across all dimensions and stakeholders; stays unknown while an unknown cell could raise it, unless a known level is already 5. Customer count alone adds no score; multi-bank simultaneity needs a documented common cause.

nodes.label: Initiator Rating A (annual rate or forward-looking evidence)
nodes.norm_label: initiator rating a (annual rate or forward-looking evidence)
nodes.rationale: A is a 1-5 rank of initiator frequency/evidence within the horizon, not a final probability. Rate path uses count x 12 / observation months; rate data normally needs >=12 months and 95% coverage, and zero events in a year does not prove <0.1. New forms take a single level or unknown (no upper bound / separate A confidence by user request); legacy band data still readable by the engine.

nodes.label: Likelihood L (A x B lookup table)
nodes.norm_label: likelihood l (a x b lookup table)
nodes.rationale: L comes only from the method-version table indexed by A row and B column; L1-L5 are ranks, not precise percentages.

nodes.label: Overall Assessment Confidence
nodes.rationale: One choice for the whole dossier, not per A/B0/dimension. Undetermined or incomplete results default to low confidence, which restricts normal acceptance; confidence does not replace reasons and evidence.

nodes.label: B = min(B0, Bc) per path; scenario B = max over paths
nodes.norm_label: b = min(b0, bc) per path; scenario b = max over paths
nodes.rationale: A well-controlled path cannot compensate an open path: scenario B takes the worst (maximum) path B.

nodes.label: Precedence Rules (impact floor, active incident, binding prohibition, customer tolerance)
nodes.norm_label: precedence rules (impact floor, active incident, binding prohibition, customer tolerance)
nodes.rationale: I=5 forces at least high and I=4 at least medium; active incidents require critical priority and incident-management referral; binding prohibition yields critical and outside-acceptance-authority; exceeding customer tolerance limits general acceptance authority. Ties ordered by worse impact, customer reach, obligation proximity, then greater uncertainty.

nodes.label: Realization Path (named step chain with preventive controls)
nodes.norm_label: realization path (named step chain with preventive controls)
nodes.rationale: Chain of steps from one initiator to the same main event; normal, direct and emergency paths may have different controls. A different initiator needs its own A and assessment. Paths are retired with evidence, never assigned zero.

nodes.label: Raw Risk Score = L x I (1-25)
nodes.norm_label: raw risk score = l x i (1-25)
nodes.rationale: Integer product for valid known L and I; controls are not re-applied in the product; base level bands low 1-4, medium 5-9, high 10-15, critical 16-25. Not editable in output.

nodes.label: Scenario & Initiator Boundary (initiator / main event / consequence)
nodes.norm_label: scenario & initiator boundary (initiator / main event / consequence)
nodes.rationale: Initiator, main event and consequence must be kept distinct; each independent occurrence counted once, with a stated counting unit, out-of-count cases, observation period and coverage. Initiator definition must not change to reach a desired score; changing it forces A and B re-review. Each effect is credited in exactly one place (A, B0, E/Bc or impact).

nodes.label: Acceptance Expiry Status without Auto-Renewal
nodes.rationale: Expired status, review task and persistent escalation notice are recorded; reminders derive from method-version parameters (30 and 7 days, proportional for shorter acceptance).

nodes.label: Equal-Score Work Priority (severity, customer reach, uncertainty)
nodes.norm_label: equal-score work priority (severity, customer reach, uncertainty)

nodes.label: Method Conflict: E3 as Bc=2 (§17 example) vs Bc=3 (§15 table)
nodes.norm_label: method conflict: e3 as bc=2 (§17 example) vs bc=3 (§15 table)
nodes.rationale: Code follows the explicit §15 table; the §17 numeric example therefore does not match code output.

nodes.label: Implementation Decision: §15 Bc Table over Conflicting Document Examples
nodes.norm_label: implementation decision: §15 bc table over conflicting document examples
nodes.rationale: Following both the explicit table and examples that treat E3 as Bc=2 is impossible; the explicit §15 rule is kept and example scores differ (e.g. EX01 target 8 -> 16 critical, §17 example 8 -> 12 high).

nodes.label: Frontend Code Structure (TanStack Query, react-hook-form + Zod, i18n)
nodes.norm_label: frontend code structure (tanstack query, react-hook-form + zod, i18n)
nodes.rationale: Lazy per-route code splitting; state like filter/search/sort/page/tab kept in URL; React Compiler auto-memo requires reading form errors via useFormState/getFieldState and values via useWatch rather than form.formState/form.watch.

nodes.label: Bc E1 fallback for discredited control assessment
nodes.norm_label: bc e1 fallback for discredited control assessment
nodes.rationale: When a control assessment has a credit_problem (e.g. stale or unsupported test), the badge shows the recorded E but warns it counts as E1 when computing Bc, so unproven controls never reduce likelihood.

nodes.label: Bc rules: lowest matching Bc wins
nodes.norm_label: bc rules: lowest matching bc wins
nodes.rationale: If several Bc conditions hold, the smallest Bc is chosen; with none, the default is the largest level of the Bc scale.

nodes.label: Impact floor on decision level
nodes.rationale: Impact at or above a floor's min_impact forces at least that floor's level regardless of score; matrix cells marked 'floor' were raised above the score-based level.

nodes.label: Max impact strategy (I = max over dimensions)
nodes.norm_label: max impact strategy (i = max over dimensions)
nodes.rationale: Final impact is the largest valid level across impact dimensions and stakeholders, not a sum or average.

nodes.label: paths_v5 likelihood strategy
nodes.rationale: Per path B = min(B0, Bc); scenario B = max over paths; L is read from the A x B table (v5 sections 15 and 17).

nodes.label: Risk score = L x I
nodes.rationale: Score is likelihood times impact; risk level bands map score ranges to decision levels.

nodes.label: Solar Hijri month periods for acceptance validity
nodes.norm_label: solar hijri month periods for acceptance validity
nodes.rationale: Month-based deadlines use the Persian solar calendar, e.g. a 6-month acceptance from 10 Mehr is valid until 10 Farvardin.

nodes.label: Trial (unapproved) method version condition
nodes.rationale: Per the v5 'organizational execution condition', an unapproved version is only used for trial assessments until promulgated and does not replace current approved authorities and commitments.

nodes.label: Review completion requires all pending risks decided
nodes.norm_label: review completion requires all pending risks decided
nodes.rationale: The 'review finished' action is disabled while undecided pending risks remain; each must be converted to the register or dismissed (with optional duplicate link).

nodes.label: risk_actions.html
nodes.rationale: Top of risk page: transitions this user may perform, merge/split proposal buttons, pending change notice and merge/split lineage links; context comes from apps.workflow.context.risk_workflow. Explains why no transition is available (role mismatch or historical-only risk).

nodes.label: Assessment Methodology Version (نسخه‌ی روش)
nodes.rationale: All numbers, scales, tables, thresholds and rules live in the method version, not in code; exactly one active version (DB-enforced); v1 is a pilot built from v5; status only moves forward (draft, approved, active, archived) and non-draft content is immutable even via SQL; no version is ever deleted.

nodes.label: Assessment Result and Quality Control
nodes.rationale: Result (L, I, score range, base and decision level, overall confidence) from the engine, recomputed for drafts and frozen on approval; cycle draft -> in QC -> referred to working group -> approved; reviewer must be a different GRC member who never submitted it; escalation causes recorded; risk page shows the latest approved current decision level.

nodes.label: Assessment Types (inherent, current, target)
nodes.rationale: Inherent excludes specific controls, current is the decision basis, target forecasts post-action; AS-1405-0003 codes; method version active at creation is pinned; assessments are never deleted or overwritten.

nodes.label: Assets and Suppliers
nodes.rationale: Five asset types, optional data class, CIA label only marks which security property matters (per §8 of v5) and is not added to risk scoring.

nodes.label: Audit Log (سوابق ممیزی)
nodes.rationale: Security events and simple-history data changes are immutable even via direct SQL (PostgreSQL trigger); users with history are deactivated, never deleted; records kept at least five years and clean_old_history must never be run.

nodes.label: Banks and Services
nodes.rationale: Visibility is not restricted by bank because all users are Datin staff; RTO/MTPD/RPO recorded per service and bank in minutes, RTO >= 1 and < MTPD checked in the database; services, banks and their rows are deactivated or closed with valid-until instead of deleted.

nodes.label: Calculation Engine (موتور محاسبه)
nodes.rationale: No methodology number lives in code; every value is read from the assessment's method version so a new version works without code changes and old assessments reproduce their result. Inputs may be numbers, ranges or unknown; the score is a range and decisions use its upper bound. Six v5 example results were raised after applying the Bc table.

nodes.label: Commitments (تعهدها)
nodes.rationale: SLA/contract/regulatory/internal obligations spanning several services; all fields but title optional so incomplete commitments can be recorded and completed later.

nodes.label: Control Effectiveness Assessment (E1-E5)
nodes.rationale: Records E of a control in a scope with the §25 test sheet (CA-1405-0001); E accepted only if all criteria of that and lower levels hold (E2 proven limited effect, E3 design and operation with >= 95% coverage and sample >= 30, E4 sustained records, E5 failure/bypass testing); suspended or stale evidence counts as E1.

nodes.label: Controls and Statement of Applicability
nodes.rationale: Organization controls (CT-0007) with type, owner, performer, key-control flag and Annex A mapping; dual-purpose controls are registered as two; SoA has one row per Annex A control with mandatory reason; inconsistency warnings when not-applicable controls are mapped.

nodes.label: Dependencies and Responsibility Boundary
nodes.rationale: Each dependency targets exactly one of service, supplier or asset, enforced in the database; responsibility boundary has the five questions of §6 v5; single point of failure is flagged manually.

nodes.label: Impact Profile (پروفایل پیامد)
nodes.rationale: One column for Datin and each affected bank; per dimension S, D, F, C, R a level 0-5 with reason and evidence; zero means no effect and unknown is never filled with zero; S suggested from outage duration vs RTO/MTPD (Q56), F from gross loss vs financial basis; suggestions need a reason to override; all-zero profile invalid; I is the max valid level.

nodes.label: Intake Questionnaire (پرسشنامه‌ی ورودی)
nodes.rationale: GRC-defined questionnaires answered by unit managers (or by GRC as interview); responses start with fixed items and the eight identification questions of §4 v5; one open response per questionnaire/unit/service; returned responses have a five-working-day deadline.

nodes.label: Likelihood A (احتمال)
nodes.rationale: Two paths (§14): annual rate or forward-looking evidence, never summed or averaged; rate needs unique initiator count and observation months; insufficient data (period < 12 months, record coverage unknown or < 95%, zero events over too short a period) forces unknown or the forward-looking path.

nodes.label: Management Report (گزارش مدیریتی)
nodes.rationale: Counts risks by latest current assessment, overdue high/critical actions, invalid acceptances, valid key controls, uncertainty, dependency concentration and level/method changes; never produces sums or averages of scores; scoped by user permissions.

nodes.label: Merge and Split Proposals (ادغام و تفکیک)
nodes.norm_label: merge and split proposals (ادغام و تفکیک)
nodes.rationale: GRC proposes merge/split of an active risk with a reason (Q53); the risk owner approves or rejects with reason; ownerless risks cannot be merged/split and only one open proposal per risk. Merge closes the risk with a 'merged into' link keeping code and history; split keeps the origin and creates registered risks with new codes and 'split from' links copying key fields.

nodes.label: Methodology Document v5 (سند v5)
nodes.rationale: Source methodology document (drafted 12 Mehr 1405) from which method version 1 was built; cited section by section across the business rules.

nodes.label: My Work Page (کارهای من)
nodes.rationale: Landing page listing the user's open actions, pending result verifications, plans awaiting owner approval, merge/split proposals, risk questions, assessments awaiting QC or committee, and for GRC risks in treatment ordered by level and deadline.

nodes.label: Pending Risk (ریسک در انتظار)
nodes.rationale: Created on submission for each selected risk-indicator option and for the 'new item'; GRC converts it to a registered risk (transition 2) with prefilled fields or dismisses it with a reason.

nodes.label: Realization Path (مسیر تحقق)
nodes.rationale: Each assessment has one or more paths with steps, B0 (base capability without control credit) with reason and evidence, and preventive controls; bypasses are separate paths; barrier independence flag enables Bc=1; B = min(B0, Bc), scenario B = max over paths, L from the A x B table.

nodes.label: Reassessment and Closure (بازسنجی و بستن)
nodes.rationale: After actions the risk goes to review and back to assessment; a plan with a newer approved current assessment awaits reassessment; comparison of base, new and target assessments with up/down arrows; target met if the new assessment is complete and not above target level or upper score bound.

nodes.label: Risk Questions (پرسش‌های ریسک)
nodes.rationale: Answered by the risk unit's managers (or recorded by GRC); five working day deadline, then shown overdue; never deleted.

nodes.label: Risk Universe (جهان ریسک)
nodes.rationale: Table with one row per active service and one column per active risk category (T1-T8, §5 v5); each cell is reviewed, not relevant (reason required, DB-checked) or pending; registering a risk marks a pending cell reviewed; risks cannot be registered in a not-relevant cell and a cell with active risks cannot become not relevant; each cell shows the visible active-risk count.

nodes.label: Risk Workflow (گردش کار ریسک)
nodes.rationale: Status changes only through the Q15 transition table; each transition is kept immutably in the risk timeline with actor, time, reason and meeting date; the risk page shows only transitions possible from the current state and the user's role; rejected and closed are terminal.

nodes.label: Time-Bound Risk Acceptance (AC codes)
nodes.rationale: Bound to the approved current assessment; validity capped by decision level (low 12 months, medium 6, high 90 days, critical 30); no automatic renewal; signatures from risk owner, unit manager (medium), security committee (high/critical), senior management (customer tolerance breach or incomplete critical service); silence is not acceptance; expires and is monitored.

nodes.label: Treatment Plan and Actions (TR codes)
nodes.rationale: One plan per approved current assessment that moved the risk to treatment; deadline from the §19 table (e.g. high 10 working days, critical 3 plus 24h containment); options reduce, avoid, transfer/share, accept, with accept forbidden for high/critical (Q63); actions approved by the risk owner; action statuses planned, approved, in progress, blocked, ready for test, verified, failed.

nodes.label: v5 Compliance Completion
nodes.rationale: Re-validates E before crediting; snapshots key risk fields on approval; retirement needs evidence of path removal or legal/contractual exit; monitor_risks creates periodic, annual and expiry reviews; internal notifications with unique keys and escalation, no external mail; management report without sums or averages.

nodes.label: Working Days and Deadlines
nodes.rationale: Thursday, Friday and registered official holidays are non-working; 'n working days' excludes the start day; month deadlines use the Solar Hijri calendar and clamp to month end; hourly deadlines are exact times.

nodes.label: Cross-Page UX Rules
nodes.rationale: Show only transitions and actions possible from the current state and role, explaining impossible ones; deadlines shown with their own unit and Solar Hijri date, overdue in red with a clock icon; labels always visible with errors under the field; charts directly labeled, right-to-left time axis, no sums or averages of ordinal scores; unknown, not recorded and zero shown distinctly in text.

nodes.label: Bc Control-Reduction Table (§15)
nodes.rationale: One E2 control gives 4, E3 gives 3, E4/E5 gives 2, two independent E4/E5 controls give 1, none gives 5; when several rules apply the lowest Bc wins; v5 examples contradicting the table are corrected.

nodes.label: Control Evidence Age Limits (90/180 days)
nodes.rationale: Key-control evidence expires after 90 days and other controls after 180 days from test end; both numbers come from the method version.

nodes.label: Critical Service Coverage Metric
nodes.rationale: Active critical services with no pending cell divided by all active critical services the user can see; commitments are covered through their services. The §21 management indicator is stricter.

nodes.label: Impact Floor on Decision Level
nodes.rationale: Decision level is the level of score L x I unless the impact floor demands more: impact >= 4 at least medium, impact 5 at least high; the floor never changes the score itself.

nodes.label: Incomplete Assessment (ارزیابی ناقص)
nodes.rationale: An assessment whose unknown component could raise the result is incomplete: always low confidence, normal acceptance blocked, may be approved but cannot move the risk to treatment without a decision level.

nodes.label: Precedence Rules (قاعده‌های تقدم)
nodes.rationale: 'Event in progress' and 'binding prohibition' raise the decision level to the highest and keep the score; binding prohibition also puts the risk outside acceptance authority; 'customer tolerance breach' leaves the level but limits general acceptance authority.

nodes.label: methodversion/action.html (admin version action confirm)
nodes.rationale: Single confirmation page for copy/approve/activate; if problems exist the submit button is hidden so the draft must be fixed first.

nodes.label: MethodVersion lifecycle: copy to draft, record approval, activate
nodes.norm_label: methodversion lifecycle: copy to draft, record approval, activate
nodes.rationale: Admin object tools expose copy for any version, approval only when can_record_approval, and activation only once status is approved.

nodes.label: Multi-form Page for Impact Profile (FORM_SETS)
nodes.rationale: Each stakeholder x dimension is its own prefixed Django form (datin-S, 12-F); the bridge returns prefixed field names and merges all errors, and the UI renders them as one form grouped by stakeholder with rows named 'dimension, stakeholder' for screen readers.

nodes.label: Single Source of Rules via Django Bridge
nodes.norm_label: single source of rules via django bridge
nodes.rationale: /api/forms/?path= and /api/pages/?path= run the same Django view and return its form and data as JSON, so access control, validation, messages, audit and redirect stay in Django and are not duplicated in the UI; only allow-listed paths (bridge_pages.py) are accepted. Zod rules are only earlier feedback.

nodes.label: evidence_list.html
nodes.rationale: Filterable, paginated evidence register; 'new evidence' button only when can_create.

nodes.label: risk_list.html
nodes.rationale: Risk register list; new risks start from the scenario library.

nodes.label: scenario_list.html
nodes.rationale: Reference scenario library; every register risk can be built from one scenario.

nodes.label: scenario_risk_create.html
nodes.rationale: Register-risk-from-scenario form showing scenario details (service name snapshot, conditions, event, objective, customer, consequence) above the risk fields.

nodes.label: holiday_list.html
nodes.rationale: Official holiday list with edit/delete; Thursday and Friday are always non-working and need not be recorded.

nodes.label: change_request_detail.html
nodes.rationale: Merge/split proposal detail with risk-owner approve/reject form. Approving a merge closes the risk with the same code and history, pointing to the merge target; approving a split creates one new risk per part with a new code and 'split from' link while the original keeps its code.

nodes.label: change_request_list.html
nodes.rationale: Filterable list of merge and split change requests.

nodes.label: change_status.html
nodes.rationale: Change request status badge (pending / approved / other).

nodes.label: question_list.html
nodes.rationale: Open risk questions raised by GRC for the user's units; answer deadline is five working days.

nodes.label: transition_form.html
nodes.rationale: Risk status transition form showing current -> target status, description and unmet preconditions (problems).

nodes.label: Base Django Layout Template (Bootstrap RTL navbar)
nodes.norm_label: base django layout template (bootstrap rtl navbar)
nodes.rationale: Bootstrap RTL page shell with dropdown menu groups intentionally identical to the new UI menu in apps/api/session.py (each group named after its method stage); SoA link gated by can_view_soa and admin group by is_system_admin/can_view_audit_log; link to the new SPA ('رابط تازه'); loads bootstrap, htmx, jalalidatepicker and app.js.

nodes.label: Generic Django Form Page Template
nodes.rationale: Shared create/edit page: title, optional intro, multipart when needed, novalidate form including form_fields, save and cancel buttons.

nodes.label: Single Field Include (label, help text, errors)
nodes.norm_label: single field include (label, help text, errors)
nodes.rationale: Renders checkbox vs. normal label placement and emits help/error blocks with ids {auto_id}_helptext and {auto_id}_error for aria association.

nodes.label: HTMX Live Filter Form Include
nodes.rationale: GET filter form that htmx re-submits on submit or input (400ms debounce), swapping only #results and pushing the URL; pages must wrap table and pagination in <div id="results">.

nodes.label: Form Fields Include (non-field errors, hidden, visible fields)
nodes.norm_label: form fields include (non-field errors, hidden, visible fields)

nodes.label: Filters as Django Filter Forms Synced to URL
nodes.norm_label: filters as django filter forms synced to url
nodes.rationale: Each list's filter form is the Django filter form and its values live in the page URL so SPA and Django pages interpret filters identically; defaults via filters.defaults, 'all' is an empty parameter.

nodes.label: React Interface Design Spec (طرح رابط React)
nodes.norm_label: react interface design spec (طرح رابط react)
nodes.rationale: Calm, precise dark interface for daily GRC work (layered dark surfaces, thin lines, one violet accent, soft glow behind each page's main element), with equivalent light theme and 'follow system'; Persian, RTL, Jalali dates.

nodes.label: Navigation Groups Mirroring Method Stages
nodes.rationale: Menu names the method's stages (desk, identification, assessment, treatment, questionnaire, catalog, administration) so readers of the method document know where each page lives; groups defined in apps/api/session.py and mirrored by templates/base.html. Only simple-count queues show unread badges.

nodes.label: pending_scenario_select.html
nodes.rationale: Choose a reference scenario before registering a risk from a questionnaire pending item; lists active scenarios with active services.

nodes.label: Internal Notices & Escalation (no external messaging)
nodes.rationale: Internal notices for deadlines and escalation to authorised roles; repeated scheduler runs do not create duplicate notices; no email or external messages are sent.

nodes.label: Periodic Review & Trigger Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Periodic and annual reviews, evidence expiry, control failure, incident, change and new requirement create trackable tasks; deadlines of 1 business day for major incident/key control failure and 5 business days for new requirement/threat; shared control failure suspends its tests and opens reviews for related risks. Review periods read from the assessment's own method version.

nodes.label: evidence_detail.html
nodes.rationale: Evidence detail page: shows confidential and expired badges, kind, source, reliability, valid-until, linked risks the viewer can see, attachments and comments.

nodes.label: evidence_table.html
nodes.rationale: Shared evidence table (code, title, kind, date, reliability with expired badge, access class).

nodes.label: risk_detail.html
nodes.rationale: Risk file page composing workflow actions, scenario-change warning, risk attributes (snapshot vs. legacy fields), external links, assessments, treatment, current controls, evidence, timeline, attachments and comments. Missing evidence is explicitly not grounds for rejecting a risk; the risk is assessed with more uncertainty.

nodes.label: ERM / Color Tokens
nodes.rationale: Surface, sidebar, text, brand (#1E3A8A), gold accent, border and status token groups in Light mode.

nodes.label: Component Library (01 Design System)
nodes.rationale: Button, Risk Level Badge, Risk Score Chip, Status Badge (7 tones), Nav Item, Avatar, Form Field, Choice, Tab, Sidebar, Topbar, 54 outline icons, logo mark.

nodes.label: Designed Pages v1
nodes.rationale: My Work, Management Report, Risk Register, Risk File, Assessment File (QC), Impact Profile, Treatment Plan, Risk Acceptance (signer view), Risk Universe, Questionnaire Response.

nodes.label: ERM Figma Design File
nodes.rationale: Pages: 00 Cover, 01 Design System, 02 Pages.

nodes.label: Page Frame Layout
nodes.rationale: 1440px desktop, 240px sidebar on the right edge, 56px topbar; nav groups follow the methodology stages with only the active group open; logical order runs right to left with the primary action at the left end.

nodes.label: Spacing, Radius and Elevation Tokens
nodes.rationale: space/1..10 = 4..40 for dashboard density; radius sm 4 to full 999; sparing elevation (Card, Popover, Focus Ring).

nodes.label: Typography (Vazirmatn, IBM Plex Mono)
nodes.rationale: Vazirmatn for all text and Persian digits, IBM Plex Mono for record codes (RK-, AS-, TR-, AC-, EV-, CT-); paragraphs starting with a Latin word are laid out LTR.

nodes.label: Evidence (شاهد)
nodes.rationale: Document supporting the level or state of one or more risks (§20 v5); auto code EV-1405-0007; never deleted; has source, date, scope, reliability, valid-until (not before date, DB-checked), access class and owner; expired when valid-until passed; confidential evidence visible only to GRC, admin, scoped auditor, evidence owner and owners of its risks.

nodes.label: External Link (پیوند بیرونی)
nodes.rationale: The same risk's identifier in another system (change, incident, problem, vulnerability, contract, supplier, continuity plan); one ref per kind per risk; links are edited, never deleted.

nodes.label: Reference Scenario (سناریوی مرجع)
nodes.rationale: Generic risk template not bound to a service, asset or bank (§6 v5); auto code like SC-0012; never deleted and inactive scenarios cannot spawn risks; versioned by 'substantial change' and each risk keeps the version it was built from so the risk page warns on later changes.

nodes.label: Risk Register (رجیستر ریسک)
nodes.rationale: Each risk gets an auto code with the Solar Hijri year (RK-1405-0012) that restarts yearly and is never reused; a risk without scenario is a 'new item'; unit defaults to service owner unit and category to scenario category; GRC and admins edit, visibility follows service rules on the risk's own unit and owner.

nodes.label: ERM Design System (MASTER)
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for the new ERM UI design system, designed from scratch and independently of the frontend/ folder; a per-page pages/<page>.md file overrides these rules.

nodes.label: Design Direction (ui-ux-pro-max)
nodes.rationale: Internal Persian RTL enterprise risk & compliance dashboard for daily desktop work; Banking/Traditional Finance and B2B Service profiles (rtl full); Accessible & Ethical + Minimalism & Swiss + Data-Dense Dashboard with mirrored charts and time axes; anti-patterns: playful design, purple/pink gradients, hiding credibility and decision authority, color alone for meaning.

nodes.label: Risk Level Color Scale
nodes.rationale: Low green, medium yellow, high orange, critical red, none grey; level colors belong to the method version and always come with a text label; impact severity 0-5 uses a monochrome brand ramp so it is not confused with risk level colors; risk level badge is a pill with a dot while workflow status badges have 4px corners.

nodes.label: action_list.html (treatment actions list)
nodes.rationale: Overdue means the due date has passed and the result is not yet verified.

nodes.label: my_work_sections.html (My Work task queues)
nodes.rationale: Sections: my actions, actions to verify, plans awaiting approval, plans ready for reassessment, acceptances to sign, acceptances expiring within 30 days, risks awaiting a treatment plan (ordered by decision level, score, due date), QC queue, workgroup referrals, merge/split change requests, risk questions, monitoring reviews and notices.

nodes.label: reassessment_form.html (record plan reassessment)
nodes.rationale: Warns that unverified actions stay open when the plan closes.

nodes.label: attachments.html (record attachments partial)
nodes.rationale: Context comes from records.record_extras; record is the page's record.

nodes.label: comments.html (record comments partial)
nodes.rationale: Anyone who can see the record may comment; only the author may edit their comment.

nodes.label: Risk acceptance signature workflow
nodes.rationale: Draft is submitted for signing only when problems are cleared; the text is then locked so authorities sign exactly that text. Each authority row (risk owner, unit managers, senior management via official letter, committee via minutes) approves or rejects with reference/letter; acceptance can later be revoked with a reason.

nodes.label: Acceptance validity cap per decision level
nodes.norm_label: acceptance validity cap per decision level
nodes.rationale: The decision level's acceptance_value and acceptance_unit cap the acceptance end date (shown as cap).

nodes.label: Treatment action lifecycle (planned, approved, ready, in_progress, verified)
nodes.norm_label: treatment action lifecycle (planned, approved, ready, in_progress, verified)
nodes.rationale: A planned action becomes approved only when the risk owner approves the plan; progress is recorded only while the risk is in treatment execution, by the action owner and assignee, and the verifier confirms the deliverable. A verified action is closed (section 20) and its effect on the risk is seen through plan reassessment. Actions can depend on other actions and carry an effect mechanism, deliverable and acceptance criteria.

nodes.label: Risk-owner treatment plan approval
nodes.rationale: Only the risk owner approves; approval makes the plan and all its actions approved, and newly added actions wait for owner approval again. Outstanding problems must be fixed before approval.

nodes.label: Treatment plan reassessment (section 20)
nodes.rationale: After a new current assessment is approved, the result is compared with the plan's baseline and target assessments and an accept-or-continue decision is recorded before a new plan round; the decision sets the next round's plan option. A warning notes when the method version changed, since part of the difference may come from the method.

nodes.label: Assessment quality-control review and security workgroup referral
nodes.norm_label: assessment quality-control review and security workgroup referral
nodes.rationale: QC is done by a different GRC member than the assessor (approve, return, or refer to the security workgroup). A workgroup decision is recorded by a workgroup member or another GRC member not party to the dispute. An approved assessment is locked and the next assessment is a new row.

nodes.label: monitoring service / monitor_risks command
nodes.rationale: Hourly monitoring of risk, acceptance and evidence expiry, reviews and internal notices. In development run `monitor_risks --watch --interval 3600`; without --watch it runs once, suitable for cron; in production the monitoring container does it after web is ready.

nodes.label: Version 5 compliance and monitoring (docs/v5-logic-changes.md)
nodes.rationale: Management report at /reports/, monitoring notices at /actions/notices/ and review tasks in My Work; logic changes, document references, example contradictions, tests and migration guide are in docs/v5-logic-changes.md.

nodes.label: comparison_table.html (Assessment Comparison Table)
nodes.rationale: Rows are components, columns are assessments (code, kind, method version, incomplete flag). Base level and decision level rows are rendered as level badges; other cells show the value with an up or down trend arrow against the first column.

nodes.label: level_badge.html (Risk Level Badge)
nodes.rationale: Colored badge from level.color and level.text_color with the level name; a dash when no level is set.

nodes.label: No automatic acceptance renewal
nodes.rationale: After the end date an acceptance is expired; there is no automatic renewal, so continuing requires a new acceptance (linked via renews) with all signatures again. A warning appears when 30 or fewer days remain.

nodes.label: Silence is not acceptance (section 25)
nodes.rationale: Silence, delayed response or lack of budget never counts as acceptance; a decision deadline is tracked and flagged when passed.

nodes.label: Temporary exceptional acceptance for plan-required levels (section 19)
nodes.norm_label: temporary exceptional acceptance for plan-required levels (section 19)
nodes.rationale: For decision levels where a treatment plan is mandatory, acceptance is only temporary and exceptional and is recorded alongside the treatment plan.

nodes.label: Radix-based UI Component Library
nodes.rationale: Components in src/components/ui built on Radix with Lucide icons, each with normal/hover/focus/disabled/busy/error states; dialogs trap and return focus (useReturnFocus); ConfirmDialog focuses Cancel first; Jalali DatePicker follows WAI-ARIA APG grid pattern with conversion matching Django jdatetime over 21,900 days; AppLink vs ClassicLink route to SPA or classic Django pages.

nodes.label: Answered options are deactivated, not deleted
nodes.norm_label: answered options are deactivated, not deleted
nodes.rationale: Text questions need no options; yes/no questions get auto-generated options if none given; an option that already has answers cannot be deleted, only deactivated, to preserve answer history.

nodes.label: Eight identification-session questions (v5 section 4)
nodes.rationale: Each non-structured response starts with unit core functions and the eight session questions (outcome, commitment, disruptive event, conditions, consequence, dependency, evidence, current control), then questionnaire questions, then a free-text 'new item'.

nodes.label: Risk-indicator option creates pending risk
nodes.rationale: Selecting an option flagged indicates_risk creates a 'pending risk' for GRC review, optionally pre-linked to a reference scenario and category.

nodes.label: Risk Assessment Items Guide
nodes.rationale: Describes each risk-assessment module item, its place in the declared method (section numbers refer to the method text) and current system behaviour; explicitly separates what the method requires from what is automated vs. left to assessor judgement.

nodes.label: V5 Logic Change Report (Datin Risk Management v5)
nodes.norm_label: v5 logic change report (datin risk management v5)
nodes.rationale: Compares code at commit f73ea67 against the v5 Word document; the engine already implemented the v5 model (A, B0, Bc, B=min, L from AxB, I=max S/D/F/C/R, LxI, impact floor), so this was gap-filling, not a CIA-to-v5 conversion. Software does not perform organisational approval, authority assignment or field pilot.

nodes.label: Datin Risk Management Document v5 (مدیریت-ریسک-داتین-v5.docx)
nodes.rationale: Reference source dated 12 Mehr 1405, SHA-256 c6c7cc34...; self-described as 'proposed for approval'.

nodes.label: Attachments and Comments
nodes.rationale: Attachments max 20 MB with type whitelist and content sniffing, stored under random names outside the public folder and served by nginx after an access check; never deleted. Comments editable only by their author with history; never deleted.

nodes.label: methodology/includes/scale.html (scale levels table)
nodes.rationale: Reused for every likelihood and impact scale; level-name and numeric-bound columns appear only when the scale defines them.

nodes.label: One-Button Bridge Actions with ConfirmDialog
nodes.rationale: Submit, approve, return, refer, delete path, sign, cancel etc. post via useBridgeAction to the same Django view; irreversible actions are confirmed first; a button exists only when Django permitted it and supplied its URL.

nodes.label: Dossier Layout Pattern (Section, DossierLayout, SectionNav, DocSection)
nodes.norm_label: dossier layout pattern (section, dossierlayout, sectionnav, docsection)
nodes.rationale: Every record (risk, assessment, service, control, plan, action, acceptance, evidence, response, review) uses one layout: header, card Sections, sticky side column with section list and Facts. Assessment dossier sections follow method order: result, scope and assumptions, impact (I), likelihood (L), quality review; decision level is highlighted at the top.

nodes.label: risk_status.html
nodes.rationale: Risk lifecycle status badge; adds a 'needs completion' badge when initiator, count unit or scope has not been written yet.

nodes.label: Risk Lifecycle (8 statuses, Q15)
nodes.rationale: Awaiting answers, registered, in assessment, rejected, treatment plan, in treatment, in review, closed; new risks start as registered; rejected and closed are not active; risks are never deleted.

nodes.label: Needs Completion Flag (نیازمند تکمیل)
nodes.rationale: Automatic flag that stays on until initiator, count unit and scope are written.

nodes.label: risk_timeline.html
nodes.rationale: Bottom of risk page: questions raised during assessment (with due/overdue state and answers) and the status transition history table.
